messages:
elaine: Quick ping — PR #418 (sdk-examples-update) failed the preview build. We have lint + spell + preview rendering errors. Need to get green before tomorrow's merge cutoff.

Docs-ci-bot: PR 418 preview failed
• markdownlint: MD013 (line length) in docs/sdk/js/quickstart.md: line 101
• vale: 2 issues (passive voice; consistency/style)
• spellcheck: flagged "authetication" (suggest: "authentication") and "re-occuring" (suggest: "recurring")
Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-418

sam: I can tackle vale and style. Can someone paste the exact vale output?

elaine: Copy from logs:
```
Line 14: PassiveVoice: "is being returned" -> use active voice
Line 86: Consistency: "Redwood" vs "redwood" capitalization
```

ravi: I see a Liquid include error in the render: include file sdk/js/snippets/example.md not found. Probably a path change in the repo.

juno: also noticed one JS snippet still uses old API name `generateText()` — needs to be `createCompletion()` and that broke the fenced code block (unclosed backticks) in one spot.

sam: pushing a small branch docs/418-vale to fix casing and passive voice, and will normalize 'Redwood' capitalization across the file.

ravi: I'll update the include path and fix the typos. Suggest using a safe include guard so preview doesn't hard-fail:
```
{% if include.exists %}
  {% include sdk/js/snippets/example.md %}
{% endif %}
```

elaine: Merge cutoff is tomorrow 09:30 PT. We need green preview + 1 more approver. @sam please handle vale, @ravi links/spellcheck, @lex can you do a quick tech glance?

lex: Happy to — will review this afternoon. If CI is green I'll give a +1.

sam: Done — pushed docs/418-vale-fixes. Ran vale locally: no issues.

ravi: Pushed docs/418-fix-links-spell. Fixed include to /docs/sdk/js/snippets/example.md, corrected auth typo and 'recurring'. Also fixed the code block (closed backticks) and updated function name to `createCompletion()`.

Docs-ci-bot: New preview for PR 418: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-418/changes
Checks: markdownlint ✅, vale ✅, spellcheck ✅, linkcheck ✅

lex: Reviewed. Minor comment on the JS snippet return typing; added a one-line comment. LGTM.

elaine: Great — merging at 09:30 unless anyone objects. Will squash and add a changelog entry.

juno: thanks all. opened #512 to add CI guard macros for missing includes so future previews don't explode.

Docs-ci-bot: PR 418 merged by elaine at 1792007890
